ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What will happen to the fish population if the raccoon population decreases?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, and the arrows indicate from the food or prey that is eaten to the animal that eats it. In the figure, an arrow from Fish to Raccoons can be seen, indicating that raccoons eat fish. Reasoning: The question asks what would happen to the number of fish if the number of raccoons decreases. Raccoons are predators of fish; when predators decrease, the predation pressure on fish decreases, so the fish population usually increases.
